description: Phase 2: TOTP verification with atomic replay protection. Add totp_auth.verify_totp() - a structured-result verifier that walks the +/-1 step window itself (pyotp's bare verify() cannot report WHICH step matched, audit finding C3), compares with hmac.compare_digest, and claims the matched (factor_id, time_step) through db.mfa_try_consume_totp_step so the INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING is the acceptance decision. Keeps totp_auth.verify_code's bool contract byte-for-byte as a legacy wrapper (plan decision D1) and migrates the three auth.py call sites. Derives clock-drift suspicion from mfa_events instead of adding a column (D3) and surfaces it on the dashboard (D4). Adds the two db.py accessors Phase 2 and 3 both need, and the hermetic sqlite test store the concurrency proof requires. Implements plan steps 1-7. Independent of FEAT-002's rate limiting, but must land FIRST: FEAT-002 wires its limiter into the same three routes and reuses tests/mfa_sqlite_store.py and db.mfa_recent_attempts from this feature.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/task-mfa-phase2-3/context.json and .agents/tasks/mfa-phase2-3-plan.md FIRST. Decisions D1-D5, D7 in that plan are binding; do not re-decide them.

Re-measure and record the scoped baseline before editing: $env:PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8"; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest tests.test_auth_2fa tests.test_admin_security. Expect 79 tests with exactly one error (test_connection_execute_wraps_rows_consistently, psycopg2 absent, pre-existing - never fix or weaken it).

Plan step 2: append two accessors to db.py section 10 in that section's existing style (%s placeholders, transaction()/connect(), as_utc() for timestamps, docstring stating arguments are never logged): mfa_get_or_create_totp_factor_id(user_id, label='legacy:users.totp_secret') using INSERT INTO mfa_factors (user_id, type, label) ... ON CONFLICT (user_id, type, label) DO NOTHING then SELECT id::text (type='totp', secret_encrypted left NULL - this is a replay ANCHOR, not a migration of users.totp_secret), and mfa_recent_attempts(since, user_id=None, ip_hash=None, limit=200) returning attempt_type/success/created_at ordered created_at DESC, modelled on mfa_count_recent_attempts at db.py:599.

Plan step 3: add verify_totp (plus a small canonical_code format guard) to totp_auth.py exactly per plan decision D5 - cheap format guard (digits only, exact length) with ZERO DB calls and no event, candidate steps [s-1, s, s+1] from totp.timecode(now) with per-step totp.generate_otp(step) compared via hmac.compare_digest and NO early break, injectable consume_step/log_event/recent_events hooks defaulting to the db functions, return {'ok','reason','drift_notice'} where reason is one of ok/invalid/replay/locked/expired_pending and the matched step is never revealed, the D3 drift derivation from mfa_recent_events, and fail-closed reason='locked' plus a replay_store_unavailable event when the replay store errors. Leave verify_code behaviourally identical with a docstring marking it legacy/compat-only.

Plan step 4: create tests/mfa_sqlite_store.py - a hermetic real-sqlite store (temp dir per instance, close(), MFA_SQLITE_DDL imported from tests.test_mfa_schema_sqlite so there is only one DDL translation) exposing try_consume_totp_step (per-thread connection, BEGIN IMMEDIATE, INSERT, sqlite3.IntegrityError => False), record_attempt, recent_attempts, log_event, recent_events, and a calls list so tests can assert 'no DB access'.

Plan step 5: write tests/test_totp_replay.py covering all Phase 2 required cases - same code twice (second => replay); TWO REAL THREADS released by a threading.Barrier against one temp sqlite DB yielding exactly one ok and one replay with exactly one row for that step, looped ~20x; a code from two steps ago rejected; a code from one step ago accepted exactly once; non-numeric and wrong-length input rejected with the store's calls list empty; the failure path writes an mfa_events row containing neither the submitted code nor the secret; the factor_id=None enrolment path accepts without touching the replay store.

Plan step 6: migrate the three verify_code call sites in auth.py (/2fa/setup at :618 with factor_id=None, /2fa/verify at :688 and /2fa/disable at :714 with the anchor factor_id from db.mfa_get_or_create_totp_factor_id, failing closed on any anchor error). Map every reason (invalid/replay/locked) onto the SAME generic message and status the current invalid-code path uses, so nothing new is revealed. Set session['mfa_clock_drift'] after start_session when drift_notice is true, expose mfa_clock_drift_notice from auth._inject with no DB read, and add one additive alert block to templates/dashboard.html.

Plan step 7: rewrite the two mock.patch.object(totp_auth, 'verify_code', ...) sites in tests/test_auth_2fa.py:311,323 to patch verify_totp returning the dict shape, and add route tests for a replayed code (same status and text as invalid) and for the drift notice. Keep every existing assertion; extend, never delete or weaken.
Re-run the scoped baseline plus the new modules and confirm the only non-pass is still the pre-existing psycopg2 error. Record the measured numbers in this FEAT's findings field.

findings:
LANDED (plan steps 1-7). Nothing committed; the working tree is the deliverable.

MEASURED TEST NUMBERS
- Baseline re-measured before editing: `unittest tests.test_auth_2fa tests.test_admin_security` -> Ran 79 tests, FAILED (errors=1) = test_admin_security.py:430 test_connection_execute_wraps_rows_consistently (psycopg2 absent, pre-existing, untouched).
- After FEAT-001: same command -> Ran 84 tests, FAILED (errors=1), still ONLY that same pre-existing error. +5 tests, all in Test2FAVerify.
- `unittest tests.test_totp_replay` -> Ran 16 tests, OK, on two consecutive runs (5.0s then 6.2s); the 20-round two-thread race was not flaky.
- Phase 1 regression set (test_mfa_crypto, test_mfa_startup_config, test_mfa_schema_sqlite, test_rotate_mfa_key) -> Ran 54 tests, OK (unchanged).
- `python -c "import db, totp_auth, auth"` -> 'imports ok' (no import cycle from totp_auth's new `import db`).

EXACT SIGNATURES ADDED (all additive; no existing signature changed)
- db.mfa_get_or_create_totp_factor_id(user_id, label="legacy:users.totp_secret") -> str|None. INSERT INTO mfa_factors (user_id, type, label) VALUES (%s::uuid, %s, %s) ON CONFLICT (user_id, type, label) DO NOTHING, then SELECT id::text AS id FROM mfa_factors WHERE user_id = %s::uuid AND type = %s AND label = %s. Inside one db.transaction(). secret_encrypted stays NULL (D2 anchor, NOT a migration of users.totp_secret).
- db.mfa_recent_attempts(since, user_id=None, ip_hash=None, limit=200) -> rows of (attempt_type, success, created_at), ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT %s, uses db.as_utc(since). Placed immediately before mfa_log_event in section 10. FEAT-002 can use this as-is for 'failures since last success'.
- totp_auth.canonical_code(code, digits=6) -> str|None. Strips, requires exactly `digits` ASCII '0'-'9' (str.isdigit deliberately avoided: it accepts Arabic-Indic digits).
- totp_auth.verify_totp(secret, code, *, factor_id=None, user_id=None, now=None, valid_window=1, digits=6, consume_step=None, log_event=None, recent_events=None) -> {"ok": bool, "reason": str, "drift_notice": bool}. reason in totp_auth.VERIFY_REASONS = ("ok","invalid","replay","locked","expired_pending"); `expired_pending` is reserved for the ROUTE's own pending-state expiry and is never produced by this function. Matched step is never returned, logged or hinted at.
- totp_auth module constants: CODE_DIGITS=6, VERIFY_REASONS, _DRIFT_RUN_THRESHOLD=5, _DRIFT_EVENT_LIMIT=25, _ACCEPT_EVENTS. Private helpers: _result, _log(log_event, event_type, user_id), _as_utc_datetime(now), _drift_suspected(user_id, log_event=None, recent_events=None).
- totp_auth.verify_code: signature and behaviour BYTE-FOR-BYTE unchanged; only the docstring changed (marked legacy/compat-only, points at verify_totp). TestTOTPModule passes untouched.
- auth._verify_totp_for_user(secret, code, user_id) -> the same dict. Resolves the anchor via db.mfa_get_or_create_totp_factor_id(str(user_id)) and FAILS CLOSED: DatabaseUnavailable / any exception / falsy anchor -> logs mfa_events 'replay_store_unavailable' (actor='auth') and returns reason='locked' WITHOUT calling verify_totp. auth._TOTP_REJECTED is the shared invalid literal. FEAT-002 should call its limiter BEFORE this helper (it is the first thing that touches the DB on the code path).
- tests/mfa_sqlite_store.py: SqliteMfaStore() with .path, .calls (list of accessor names, for 'no DB access' assertions), .inspect(sql, params=()) (reads WITHOUT appearing in .calls), .close(); accessors try_consume_totp_step(factor_id, time_step, user_id=None), record_attempt(attempt_type, success, user_id=None, ip_hash=None, created_at=None), recent_attempts(since, user_id=None, ip_hash=None, limit=200), count_recent_attempts(since, user_id=None, ip_hash=None, attempt_type=None, success=None), log_event(event_type, actor=None, user_id=None, ip_hash=None, user_agent_hash=None, created_at=None), recent_events(user_id=None, limit=100). Module helper sqlite_timestamp(value=None) renders UTC second-precision like sqlite CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.
- tests/test_auth_2fa.py module constants VERIFY_OK / VERIFY_DRIFT / VERIFY_INVALID / VERIFY_REPLAY / VERIFY_LOCKED (the dict shapes) - reuse these in FEAT-002's route tests.

FILES CHANGED: db.py (2 accessors appended into section 10), totp_auth.py (+hmac/datetime/`import db`, canonical_code, verify_totp and helpers, verify_code docstring), auth.py (_verify_totp_for_user + 3 migrated call sites + drift session flag + _inject key), templates/dashboard.html (one additive alert block at the top of {% block content %}), tests/test_auth_2fa.py.
FILES CREATED: tests/mfa_sqlite_store.py, tests/test_totp_replay.py.
UNTOUCHED (verified with git diff): supabase/schema.sql, mfa_crypto.py, app_clean.py, db.connect()/db.transaction(), users.totp_secret handling, auth.login_limiter / signup_limiter / _RateLimiter. The only removed lines in auth.py are the three `totp_auth.verify_code(...)` call lines.

DEVIATIONS / ADDITIONS BEYOND THE LITERAL PLAN (each with its reason)
1. tests/mfa_sqlite_store.py also exposes count_recent_attempts and an optional `created_at=` kwarg on record_attempt/log_event. Reason: FEAT-002 must inject a fixed clock instead of sleeping, and db.mfa_count_recent_attempts already exists, so the test store had to mirror it. Additive only - plan step 4's five accessors are all present with db.py-compatible signatures.
2. recent_events / recent_attempts in the sqlite store order by `created_at DESC, rowid DESC`. Reason: sqlite CURRENT_TIMESTAMP has one-second granularity, so events written inside one test tie and the drift run would be measured in an arbitrary order. Test-only ordering refinement; Postgres (timestamptz, microseconds) needs no equivalent.
3. Foreign keys are left at sqlite's default (OFF) in the test store, matching tests/test_mfa_schema_sqlite.py. Reason: a test must be able to claim a step for a synthetic factor_id with user_id=None without materialising users/mfa_factors rows.
4. make_app() in tests/test_auth_2fa.py gained the endpoint name "satellite_map" and a test-only route /_probe/dashboard that renders the real dashboard.html. Reason: the existing "dashboard" rule is a stub lambda, so without the probe the drift-notice template block could not be asserted end-to-end; dashboard.html:303 calls url_for('satellite_map'), which the fixture did not register. No existing assertion was changed.
5. The D3 drift read-back runs after EVERY accepted code (exactly as D3 says), not only on skew. One indexed SELECT per successful 2FA verification; never on failure, never per request.
6. `verify_totp(now=...)` accepts a datetime (naive is treated as local, per db.as_utc's convention) or epoch seconds. The plan only said `now=None`; tests needed a fixed instant.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGES THAT LANDED (plan section 1, items 1, 3, 6, 7 - items 2, 4, 5, 8 belong to FEAT-002)
- /2fa/verify and /2fa/disable now reject a code already used for its time step. /2fa/setup is verified with factor_id=None (no replay store at enrolment).
- invalid / replay / locked all render the IDENTICAL existing generic text and status: /2fa/verify -> 401 + 'Invalid code. Please try again.' (asserted equal to the invalid-code response, and asserted not to contain 'replay'/'reused'/'already'/'locked'/'time step'); /2fa/setup -> redirect + 'Invalid code. Please check your authenticator app and try again.'; /2fa/disable -> redirect to dashboard + 'Invalid code - 2FA was not disabled.' Pending 2FA state is NOT consumed on rejection.
- Wrong-length / non-numeric / non-ASCII-digit codes are now rejected before any DB work (asserted via store.calls == []).
- A row may now be created in mfa_factors (type='totp', label='legacy:users.totp_secret', secret_encrypted NULL) for an existing 2FA user on their first verification after this phase.
- New mfa_events event_type values written: totp_verify_failed, totp_verify_ok_exact, totp_verify_ok_skew, totp_replay_rejected, clock_drift_suspected, replay_store_unavailable. event_type is free text in schema.sql:722 - no DDL change. mfa_lockout is still unused (FEAT-002).
- session['mfa_clock_drift'] is set right after start_session in /2fa/verify and /2fa/setup when drift_notice is true; auth._inject exposes mfa_clock_drift_notice (session read only, no DB); templates/dashboard.html renders one dismissible warning. The flag lives until the session is cleared (logout / next start_session) - there is no MFA settings page to own it yet.

- FakeDB (tests/fake_db.py:120) returns a non-empty cursor for INSERT ... RETURNING, so under FakeDB db.mfa_try_consume_totp_step ALWAYS reports 'newly inserted' (accept). Route tests therefore prove wiring, never atomicity; the real proof is tests/test_totp_replay.py's 20-round two-thread race against a real sqlite file (D7).
- MFA_IP_PEPPER is unset in this environment; nothing in FEAT-001 calls mfa_crypto.ip_hash, so no ip_hash is written yet. FEAT-002 still owns the degrade-to-None path.
